RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the appointed candidate are women, so sex was not a factor in choosing her over you. Raising the panel's gender composition has no legal or logical relevance to a discrimination claim and will undermine your credibility. 

While you appear to have more formal leadership credentials and administrative experience, final selections frequently hinge on interview performance, references, stakeholder alignment, or school culture fit. 

Do not mention the panel's composition. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting your written feedback, framing it as an effort to understand what competencies or criteria tipped the balance and how you can strengthen future applications.
